## Do you like Codespaces?

I think github codespaces are an incredible tool for developers with so
many features that smooth away some of the rough edges associated with
developing with containers. 

However, if you find yourself to be a fellow R enjoyer, you might
find that the R experience with Visual Studio Code is a bit lacking. 
It can be made to work, but never truly feels like a good developer
experience to me.  I've been incorporating Posit's Positron
IDE into more and more of my workflows lately. I am a long time
Rstudio user and I've completely replaced that with Positron - I
am that enamoured with it.  

> Wouldn't it be great if I could get that codespace experience
> up and running with Positron?

And how great would it be if I could access that environment 
from just about anywhere I have an internet connection. 

If you, like me find yourself yearning for those same things
and you haven't yet found a solution? Then I think I have
a developer experience concoction you may want to take
a look at.


## Enter DevPod

Devpod is essentially the opensource equivalent to codespaces
that users can run on their own hardware. It's a great
piece of software that has a GUI for folks who like
those and a cli component for folks looking to
stay in the terminal.





## Tailscale

Tailscale is a is a service that allows you to connect
your devices into it own private little network.
